evals.name: json-export
evals.prompt: Our nightly stock reconciliation job needs JSON from this exporter. Add --format json to the existing export command; keep table as the default and support --format table too. Use the record shape described in the README, including empty inventories, and make JSON mode work with the existing --output option. Preserve the existing operator workflows and add useful regression tests. Run scala-cli test . --server=false.
evals.expected_output: A compatible JSON export feature usable by the nightly job, including file output and predictable command failures.
expectations: JSON stdout is one complete array with correct fields, escaping, types and input ordering.
Empty JSON exports produce an empty array and succeed.
JSON file export writes the payload without emitting data or completion chatter on stdout.
Explicit force replaces an existing JSON file correctly.
Unattended overwrite refuses promptly without prompting or modifying the file.
Invalid output formats and incomplete options report usage failure before modifying an output.
Missing or malformed sources and unwritable destinations fail with useful stderr and no stdout payload.
Existing table stdout and file-output contracts remain compatible.
Help advertises the JSON option and version remains available without reading input.
